crop.notes: Whole 'The Courts' column of unrelated items; only the last paragraph is about Allen

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Democrat reported that Tom Allen, Johnnie Smith, Sam Smith and Jim Eagan were called in Police Court over their Sunday chase after Ben Hogan, but few witnesses appeared and they were discharged.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'The St. Louis Democrat: St. Louis, Wednesday, December 10, 1873'; Globe-Democrat did not exist until 1875

facts.fact: Allen, Johnnie Smith, Sam Smith and Jim Eagan were discharged in the St. Louis Police Court, without making a defense, on charges over their Sunday chase after Ben Hogan
